blocks.text: by va until: ikki xil «... gacha»

O'zbekchadagi «**-gacha**» qo'shimchasi ingliz tilida ikki xil so'z bilan beriladi va ular butunlay boshqa ma'noni bildiradi. **until** (og'zaki — **till**) — holat yoki harakat shu vaqtgacha **davom etadi**, keyin to'xtaydi: I'll wait **until** six — Soat oltigacha kutaman. **by** — harakat shu vaqtdan **kechikmay**, undan oldin yoki aynan o'shanda **bajariladi**: I'll be back **by** six — Eng kechi soat oltida qaytaman. until asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 104-dars); by ning boshqa ma'nolari (by car, by mistake) — → 128-dars.

rows: wait, stay, work, be open, last
finish, send, pay, arrive, be ready
**By the time** we arrived, they'd gone.

blocks.text: **by** + vaqt — **deadline**: harakat shu nuqtadan oldin tugashi kerak, aniq qachon bo'lishi muhim emas. Shuning uchun by ko'pincha bir martalik, natijali fe'llar bilan keladi: finish, send, pay, arrive, be ready, decide. O'zbekchada «**... gacha**», «**eng kechi bilan**», «**... ga qadar ulgurmoq**» deb beriladi. Kelajakda ham, o'tmishda ham ishlatiladi: Most guests had left **by** midnight.

items.text: Can you let me know your decision **by** Thursday?
The new sofa should arrive **by** the weekend.
items.translation: Yangi divan dam olish kunlari**gacha** yetib kelishi kerak.

blocks.text: **until** dan oldingi fe'l **davom etadigan** holatni bildiradi: shu vaqtgacha uzluksiz qolamiz, kutamiz, ishlaymiz. until dan keyin ot ham (**until** Monday), gap ham (**until** I come back) keladi; kelajak ma'nosida gapda Present ishlatiladi (→ 25-dars). Inkor bilan **not ... until** — «faqat o'shanda»: I won't know **until** Friday — Jumagacha bilmayman, ya'ni faqat jumada bilaman. Kuchli shakl: It wasn't **until** ... that ... — «faqat ... -gandagina».

items.text: I'll be in Bukhara **until** Sunday, then I'm flying home.
items.translation: Yakshanba**gacha** Buxoroda bo'laman, keyin uyga uchaman.

items.text: Wait here **until** I come back with the tickets.
items.translation: Chiptalar bilan qaytib **kelgunimcha** shu yerda kut.

items.text: I won't know my exam results **until** August.

rows: I'll **wait until** six. (oltigacha kutaman, keyin ketaman)
I'll **be back by** six. (eng kechi oltida qaytaman)

blocks.text: **by the time** + gap — «**... -guncha**», «**... -gan paytda (allaqachon)**»: bir voqea sodir bo'lgan paytda ikkinchisi **tugab bo'lgan** bo'ladi. O'tmishda: by the time + Past Simple, bosh gapda odatda **Past Perfect** (→ 15-dars). Kelajakda: by the time + **Present** (will emas), bosh gapda **will** yoki **will have done** (→ 24-dars). Gap o'rniga **by then** / **by that time** — «o'sha paytga kelib» ham ishlatiladi.

items.text: **By the time** we found a table, the kitchen had stopped serving food.
items.translation: Biz bo'sh stol **topgunimizcha**, oshxona ovqat berishni to'xtatgan edi.

items.text: **By the time** you finish university, you'll speak three languages.
items.translation: Universitetni **tugatgan paytingda** uchta tilda gapiradigan bo'lasan.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «Send the report **until** Friday» («jumagacha yuboring») → **by** Friday — bu muddat, davomiylik emas. 2) «I'll wait **by** six» → I'll wait **until** six (kutish davom etadi). 3) «**By the time** we **will** arrive» → **By the time** we **arrive**. 4) «I walked **until** the station» (masofa) → I walked **as far as** / **to** the station — until faqat vaqt uchun. 5) «-gacha» ni doim until deb tarjima qilish — avval fe'lga qarang.

«-gacha» ni ikki savol bilan tekshiring: «shu vaqtgacha **davom etadimi**?» (kutish, qolish, ishlash) — **until**; «shu vaqtgacha **bajarilib bo'ladimi**?» (yuborish, tugatish, to'lash) — **by**. by ni «**eng kechi**» so'zi bilan tarjima qilib ko'ring: ma'no saqlansa — by to'g'ri.
**until** va **till** ma'nosi bir xil; till og'zaki nutqda ko'proq. «**up to**» ham vaqt uchun ishlatilishi mumkin (**up to** now — hozirgacha), lekin muddat ma'nosida faqat **by**.

rows: **By the time** I came, they'**d** left.
**By the time** you come, I'**ll have** left.

examples.title: **By** = not later than: deadlines
examples.description: by + vaqt — «eng kechi ... gacha»: harakat shu vaqtdan oldin yoki aynan o'shanda bajariladi. Ko'pincha: finish, send, pay, arrive, be ready.

sentences.text: Please send me the final version of the report **by** Friday.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, hisobotning yakuniy variantini juma**gacha** yuboring.

sentences.text: The repairs to our flat should be finished **by** the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizdagi ta'mir oy oxiri**gacha** tugashi kerak.

sentences.text: If we leave now, we'll be in Samarkand **by** lunchtime.
sentences.translation: Hozir chiqsak, tushlik**kacha** Samarqandda bo'lamiz.

sentences.text: Applications must be received **by** 15 March at the latest.
sentences.translation: Arizalar **eng kechi bilan** 15-mart**gacha** qabul qilinishi shart.

sentences.text: I need to be home **by** six to let the plumber in.
sentences.translation: Santexnikni kiritish uchun soat olti**gacha** uyda bo'lishim kerak.

sentences.text: **By** next summer, the new metro line will connect the airport to the city centre.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yoz**gacha** yangi metro liniyasi aeroportni shahar markazi bilan bog'laydi.

sentences.text: Will the documents be ready **by** Monday, or should I come back later?
sentences.translation: Hujjatlar dushanba**gacha** tayyor bo'ladimi yoki keyinroq kelaymi?

sentences.text: Madina promised to pay back the money **by** the end of the year.
sentences.translation: Madina pulni yil oxiri**gacha** qaytarishga va'da berdi.

sentences.text: You have to check out of the hotel **by** eleven o'clock.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadan soat o'n bir**gacha** chiqib ketishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Most of the guests had left **by** midnight, so we started clearing up.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning ko'pchiligi yarim tun**gacha** ketib bo'lgandi, shuning uchun yig'ishtirishni boshladik.

examples.title: **Until** = continuing up to a time
examples.description: until (og'zaki — till) — «... gacha davom etadi»: holat yoki harakat shu vaqtgacha to'xtamaydi. stay, wait, work, be open, last.

sentences.text: The supermarket on our street is open **until** midnight.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi supermarket yarim tun**gacha** ochiq.

sentences.text: Let's wait in the café **until** the rain stops.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **tingunicha** kafeda kutib turaylik.

sentences.text: Aziz is staying with us **until** he finds a flat of his own.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'zining kvartirasini **topgunicha** biznikida turibdi.

sentences.text: I worked **until** three in the morning to finish the presentation.
sentences.translation: Taqdimotni tugatish uchun tungi soat uch**gacha** ishladim.

sentences.text: The mountain road will be closed **until** further notice because of the landslide.
sentences.translation: Ko'chki tufayli tog' yo'li keyingi xabar**gacha** yopiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Keep stirring the sauce **until** it gets thick.
sentences.translation: Sous **quyuqlashguncha** aralashtirishda davom eting.

sentences.text: **Until** last year, Nilufar had never been on a plane.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yil**gacha** Nilufar hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan edi.

sentences.text: The festival lasts **until** Sunday, so there's still time to buy tickets.
sentences.translation: Festival yakshanba**gacha** davom etadi, chipta olishga hali vaqt bor.

sentences.text: Can you look after the kids **till** I get back from the shops?
sentences.translation: Men do'kondan qaytib **kelgunimcha** bolalarga qarab tura olasanmi?

sentences.text: Tom lived with his parents **until** he was thirty, which his friends found funny.
sentences.translation: Tom o'ttiz **yoshigacha** ota-onasi bilan yashadi, do'stlari buni kulgili deb bilishardi.

examples.title: **Not** ... **until**: only then
examples.description: not ... until — «... gacha ... -maydi», ya'ni harakat faqat o'shanda boshlanadi. It wasn't until ... that ... — kuchli shakl.

sentences.text: We won't know the results of the tender **until** next Wednesday.
sentences.translation: Tanlov natijalarini kelasi chorshanba**gacha** bilmaymiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't start learning English **until** he was twenty-five.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ingliz tilini **faqat** yigirma besh **yoshida** o'rgana boshladi.

sentences.text: Don't open the oven door **until** the cake is ready.
sentences.translation: Tort **pishmaguncha** duxovka eshigini ochmang.

sentences.text: The shop doesn't open **until** ten on Sundays, so we'll have to wait.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari do'kon **faqat** soat o'nda ochiladi, shuning uchun kutishimizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: I didn't realise how tired I was **until** I sat down.
sentences.translation: **O'tirgunimcha** qanchalik charchaganimni sezmagan ekanman.

sentences.text: You can't get a driving licence **until** you're eighteen.
sentences.translation: O'n sakkiz **yoshga to'lmaguningizcha** haydovchilik guvohnomasini ololmaysiz.

sentences.text: Sarah won't make a decision **until** she's spoken to her family.
sentences.translation: Oilasi bilan **gaplashmaguncha** Sara qaror qabul qilmaydi.

sentences.text: It wasn't **until** I got home that I noticed my phone was missing.
sentences.translation: Telefonim yo'qligini **faqat** uyga **kelganimda** payqadim.

sentences.text: The doctor said I shouldn't go back to work **until** my temperature is normal.
sentences.translation: Shifokor haroratim **me'yorga kelmaguncha** ishga qaytmasligim kerakligini aytdi.

sentences.text: Why didn't you tell me about the problem **until** now?
sentences.translation: Nega muammo haqida **hozirgacha** menga aytmading?

examples.title: **By** or **until**?
examples.description: by — harakat muddatgacha bajariladi (bir martalik, natijali); until — holat muddatgacha davom etadi. Juft gaplarda solishtiring.

sentences.text: I'll be at the office **until** five, so call me before then.
sentences.translation: Soat besh**gacha** ofisda bo'laman, shuning uchun undan oldin qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: I'll have finished the translation **by** five, so you can pick it up then.
sentences.translation: Tarjimani soat besh**gacha** tugatib qo'yaman, o'shanda olib ketishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: The library is open **until** eight, but you must return the books **by** seven.
sentences.translation: Kutubxona soat sakkiz**gacha** ochiq, lekin kitoblarni **eng kechi** soat yetti**gacha** qaytarishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Jasur is on holiday **until** Monday — he'll be back at work on Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Jasur dushanba**gacha** ta'tilda — seshanba kuni ishga qaytadi.

sentences.text: Jasur has to submit his visa application **by** Monday.
sentences.translation: Jasur viza arizasini dushanba**gacha** topshirishi kerak.

sentences.text: Can you wait **until** tomorrow for the money, or do you need it today?
sentences.translation: Pulni ertaga**cha** kuta olasanmi yoki bugun kerakmi?

sentences.text: If you order **by** two o'clock, your parcel will arrive the same day.
sentences.translation: Soat ikki**gacha** buyurtma bersangiz, posilkangiz o'sha kuni yetib keladi.

sentences.text: Emma stayed at the party **until** the very end, as she was having a great time.
sentences.translation: Emma ziyofatda eng **oxirigacha** qoldi, chunki unga juda yoqayotgan edi.

sentences.text: The new hospital should be completed **by** 2027.
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxona 2027-yil**gacha** qurib bitkazilishi kerak.

sentences.text: Let's not make any decisions **until** we've heard what the customers think.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar fikrini **eshitmagunimizcha** hech qanday qaror qabul qilmaylik.

examples.title: **By the time** ... in the past
examples.description: by the time + Past Simple — «... -guncha», «... -gan paytda allaqachon»: bosh gapda odatda Past Perfect (→ 15-dars). by then — «o'sha paytga kelib».

sentences.text: **By the time** the ambulance arrived, a nurse from the crowd had already helped the man.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam **yetib kelgunicha**, olomon orasidagi bir hamshira erkakka allaqachon yordam bergan edi.

sentences.text: The shops had all closed **by the time** we got back to the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga **qaytib kelganimizda** barcha do'konlar allaqachon yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: **By the time** Dilnoza finished university, she had already found a good job.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza universitetni **tugatgan paytda** allaqachon yaxshi ish topib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: I was so tired that I had fallen asleep **by the time** the film ended.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchagan edimki, film **tugaguncha** uxlab qolgan edim.

sentences.text: The bus had already left **by the time** I found my glasses.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni **topgunimcha**, avtobus jo'nab ketgan edi.

sentences.text: The thieves had disappeared **by the time** the police arrived.
sentences.translation: Politsiya **yetib kelgunicha** o'g'rilar g'oyib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: We arrived at ten, but most of the guests had gone home **by then**.
sentences.translation: Biz soat o'nda keldik, lekin **o'sha paytga kelib** mehmonlarning ko'pi uylariga ketib bo'lgandi.

sentences.text: Kate's English was almost perfect **by the time** she left Oxford.
sentences.translation: Oksforddan **ketgan paytida** Keytning inglizchasi deyarli mukammal edi.

sentences.text: I had already booked another plumber **by the time** Oliver finally called back.
sentences.translation: Oliver nihoyat qayta **qo'ng'iroq qilguncha**, men allaqachon boshqa santexnik chaqirib bo'lgandim.

sentences.text: How much of the cake was left **by the time** you arrived?
sentences.translation: Sen **kelgan paytda** tortdan qanchasi qolgan edi?

examples.title: **By the time** ... in the future; **by then**
examples.description: Kelajak: by the time + Present (will emas), bosh gapda will yoki will have done (→ 24-dars). by then / by that time — «o'sha paytga kelib».

sentences.text: **By the time** the guests arrive, the plov will be ready.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **kelguncha** palov tayyor bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The film will have finished **by the time** we get there, so let's not bother.
sentences.translation: Biz u yerga **yetib borgunimizcha** film tugagan bo'ladi, shuning uchun ovora bo'lmaylik.

sentences.text: **By the time** Jasur retires, he will have worked at the same factory for forty years.
sentences.translation: Jasur nafaqaga **chiqqan paytda** bir zavodda qirq yil ishlagan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Hurry up! All the good seats will be taken **by the time** we arrive.
sentences.translation: Shoshil! Biz **yetib borgunimizcha** barcha yaxshi joylar band bo'lib bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I'm going to finish my degree in 2028. **By then**, I'll be twenty-six.
sentences.translation: Men o'qishni 2028-yilda tugataman. **O'sha paytga kelib** yigirma olti yoshda bo'laman.

sentences.text: Will the new terminal be finished **by the time** the tourist season starts?
sentences.translation: Sayyohlik mavsumi **boshlanguncha** yangi terminal qurib bitkaziladimi?

sentences.text: Prices will probably have doubled **by the time** our children go to university.
sentences.translation: Farzandlarimiz universitetga **borgan paytda** narxlar ikki baravar oshib bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak.

sentences.text: Call me in the evening — I should be home **by then**.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qil — **o'sha paytgacha** uyda bo'lsam kerak.

sentences.text: Madina hopes to save enough for a flat **by the time** she's thirty.
sentences.translation: Madina o'ttiz **yoshga to'lguncha** kvartiraga yetarli pul yig'ishni umid qiladi.

sentences.text: The meeting ends at four, and **by that time** everyone will be desperate for coffee.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish soat to'rtda tugaydi, **o'sha paytga kelib** hamma qahvaga zor bo'lib qoladi.

examples.title: Dialogue: moving house
examples.description: Ikki do'st ko'chish rejasini muhokama qiladi: by (muddat), until (davom etish) va by the time bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Do you have to be out of your old flat **by** the end of the month?
sentences.translation: — Eski kvartirangdan oy oxiri**gacha** chiqib ketishing kerakmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, but the landlord says we can stay **until** the thirtieth.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin uy egasi o'ttizinchi sana**gacha** qolishimiz mumkinligini aytdi.

sentences.text: — And will the new flat be ready **by** then?
sentences.translation: — Yangi kvartira **o'shangacha** tayyor bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — Hopefully. The painters promised to finish **by** the twenty-eighth.
sentences.translation: — Umid qilaman. Bo'yoqchilar yigirma sakkizinchi**gacha** tugatishga va'da berishdi.

sentences.text: — That's cutting it fine! What if they keep working **until** the last minute?
sentences.translation: — Bu juda tig'iz-ku! Agar ular so'nggi daqiqa**gacha** ishlashsa-chi?

sentences.text: — Then we'll leave our things with my parents **until** everything is dry.
sentences.translation: — Unda hammasi **qurigunicha** narsalarimizni ota-onamnikida qoldiramiz.

sentences.text: — Sensible. Do you need any help? I'm free **until** Saturday afternoon.
sentences.translation: — Oqilona. Yordam kerakmi? Shanba kuni tushdan keyin**gacha** bo'shman.

sentences.text: — That would be great! Could you come round **by** nine on Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r bo'lardi! Shanba kuni soat to'qqiz**gacha** kela olasanmi?

sentences.text: — Sure. **By the time** you wake up, I'll be at your door with coffee!
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Sen **uyg'onguningcha** eshigingning oldida qahva bilan turgan bo'laman!

sentences.text: — Perfect. **By** Sunday evening, we'll hopefully be sleeping in the new place.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Yakshanba kechqurun**gacha**, umid qilamanki, yangi joyda uxlayotgan bo'lamiz.

examples.title: Mixed: plans, rules and deadlines
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: by, until, not ... until va by the time murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Most experts agree that **by** 2050 the city's population will have doubled.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik mutaxassislar 2050-yil**gacha** shahar aholisi ikki baravar ko'payib bo'lishiga qo'shiladi.

sentences.text: The new bridge won't open to traffic **until** all the safety checks are complete.
sentences.translation: Barcha xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari **tugamaguncha** yangi ko'prik transport uchun ochilmaydi.

sentences.text: **By the time** the firefighters arrived, the neighbours had already put out the fire.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar **yetib kelgunicha**, qo'shnilar olovni allaqachon o'chirib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: Students can change their optional courses **until** the end of the second week.
sentences.translation: Talabalar tanlov fanlarini ikkinchi hafta oxiri**gacha** o'zgartirishi mumkin.

sentences.text: All online tax returns have to be submitted **by** 31 January.
sentences.translation: Barcha onlayn soliq deklaratsiyalari 31-yanvar**gacha** topshirilishi shart.

sentences.text: Aziz didn't feel at home in London **until** he joined a local football club.
sentences.translation: Aziz mahalliy futbol klubiga **qo'shilmaguncha** Londonda o'zini uydagidek his qilmadi.

sentences.text: If the parcel hasn't arrived **by** Thursday, contact our customer service team.
sentences.translation: Posilka payshanba**gacha** kelmasa, mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish bo'limimizga murojaat qiling.

sentences.text: I'll keep working on the problem **until** I find a solution, however long it takes.
sentences.translation: Qancha vaqt olsa ham, yechim **topgunimcha** bu muammo ustida ishlayveraman.

sentences.text: The central heating doesn't come on **until** October, so people wear jumpers indoors in September.
sentences.translation: Markaziy isitish **faqat** oktabrda yoqiladi, shuning uchun sentabrda odamlar uyda ham sviter kiyib yurishadi.

sentences.text: Will the website be fixed **by** tomorrow morning, or should we warn the clients?
sentences.translation: Sayt ertaga ertalab**gacha** tuzatiladimi yoki mijozlarni ogohlantirishimiz kerakmi?
